## The core interfaces

- `List` — ordered, indexed, allows duplicates (`ArrayList`, `LinkedList`).
- `Set` — no duplicates (`HashSet`, `LinkedHashSet`, `TreeSet`).
- `Map` — key/value (`HashMap`, `LinkedHashMap`, `TreeMap`).

## Choosing

`ArrayList` for random access; `ArrayDeque` for stack/queue. `HashMap` for O(1) lookup, `TreeMap` for sorted keys.

## Factory methods

`List.of`, `Set.of`, `Map.of` create **immutable** collections. Copy into a mutable one if you need to modify.
